units.zh: 耶律希亮
units.en: Yelu Xiliang
units.literal: Yelu Xiliang

units.zh: 耶律希亮，字明甫，楚材之孫，鑄之子也。
units.en: Yelu Xiliang, whose style name was Mingfu, was the grandson of Yelu Chucai and the son of Yelu Zhu.
units.literal: Yelu Xiliang, styled Mingfu, was a grandson of Yelu Chucai and a son of Yelu Zhu.

units.zh: 初，六皇后命以赤帖吉氏歸鑄，生希亮於和林南之涼樓，曰禿忽思，六皇后遂以其地名之。
units.en: In the beginning, the Sixth Empress Dowager had Zhu marry a woman of the Chietieji clan. Xiliang was born at Lianglou, south of Karakorum, in a place called Tuhusi, and the empress dowager gave him that place name.
units.literal: At first, the Sixth Empress Dowager ordered that the Chietieji clan be given to Zhu in marriage; Xiliang was born at Lianglou south of Karakorum, called Tuhusi, and the Sixth Empress Dowager then named him after that place.

units.zh: 憲宗嘗遣鑄核錢糧於燕，鑄曰：「臣先世皆讀儒書，儒生俱在中土，願攜諸子，至燕受業。」
units.en: Emperor Xianzong once dispatched Zhu to Yan to audit revenue and grain accounts. Zhu said, "For generations my family has studied the Confucian classics, and the scholars we need are all in China proper. I ask leave to bring my sons to Yan for their education."
units.literal: Emperor Xianzong once sent Zhu to audit grain and funds in Yan; Zhu said: "My forebears for generations all read Confucian books, and Confucian scholars are all in the Central Plains; I wish to take my sons to Yan to pursue their studies."

units.zh: 憲宗從之，乃命希亮師事北平趙衍。
units.en: The emperor agreed and appointed Xiliang to study under Zhao Yan of Beiping.
units.literal: Emperor Xianzong assented, and then ordered Xiliang to take as his teacher Zhao Yan of Beiping.

units.zh: 時方九歲，未浹旬，已能賦詩。
units.en: He was only nine at the time, yet within ten days he was already writing verse.
units.literal: He was then just nine years old; before ten days had passed, he could already compose poetry.

units.zh: 歲丙辰，憲宗召鑄還和林，希亮獨留燕。
units.en: In the bingchen year, the emperor recalled Zhu to Karakorum while Xiliang stayed behind in Yan.
units.literal: In the year bingchen, Emperor Xianzong summoned Zhu back to Karakorum, and Xiliang alone remained in Yan.

units.zh: 歲戊午，憲宗在六盤山，希亮詣行在所。
units.en: In the wuwu year, while the emperor was encamped at Liupan Mountain, Xiliang went to join the imperial camp.
units.literal: In the year wuwu, Emperor Xianzong was at Liupan Mountain; Xiliang went to the mobile court.

units.zh: 已而鑄扈從南伐，希亮亦在行。
units.en: Soon afterward Zhu accompanied the southern expedition, and Xiliang marched with them.
units.literal: Before long Zhu followed in attendance on the southern campaign, and Xiliang was also on the march.

units.zh: 明年，憲宗崩於蜀，希亮將輜重北歸陝右。
units.en: The following year the emperor died in Shu, and Xiliang escorted the supply train northward into western Shaanxi.
units.literal: The next year, Emperor Xianzong died in Shu; Xiliang led the baggage train north back to the west of Shaan.

units.zh: 又明年，為中統元年，世祖即位，阿里不哥反，遣使召主將渾都海。
units.en: Another year passed—the first year of the Zhongtong reign. Kublai ascended the throne, Ariq Böke rose in revolt, and dispatched envoys to summon the commander Hunduhai.
units.literal: The year after that was the first year of Zhongtong; the Shizu Emperor took the throne, Ariq Böke rebelled, and sent envoys to summon the commander-in-chief Hunduhai.

units.zh: 鑄說渾都海等入朝，皆不從，則棄其妻子，挺身來歸。
units.en: Zhu urged Hunduhai and his officers to present themselves at court, but they refused. He then left his wife and children behind and came alone to Kublai's side.
units.literal: Zhu urged Hunduhai and the others to come to court; none obeyed, so he abandoned his wife and children and came alone to submit.

units.zh: 既而渾都海知鑄去，怒，遣百騎追之不及。
units.en: When Hunduhai learned of Zhu's defection, he flew into a rage and sent a hundred horsemen in pursuit, but they failed to catch him.
units.literal: When Hunduhai learned that Zhu had gone, he was angry and sent a hundred horsemen in pursuit but could not overtake him.

units.zh: 乃使百人監視希亮母子，迫脅使從行，自靈武過應吉里城，至西涼甘州。
units.en: He then placed a hundred men to guard Xiliang and his mother, forcing them to march with the army from Lingwu through Yingjili to Ganzhou in the Hexi corridor.
units.literal: He then set a hundred men to watch Xiliang and his mother, coercing them to march along, from Lingwu past Yingjili City to Ganzhou in the Hexi corridor (Xiliang).

units.zh: 阿里不哥遣大將阿藍答兒自和林帥師至焉支山，希亮見之。
units.en: Ariq Böke sent his general Alamdar from Karakorum with an army to Yanzhi Mountain, where Xiliang was brought before him.
units.literal: Ariq Böke sent the great general Alamdar from Karakorum leading troops to Yanzhi Mountain; Xiliang met him.

units.zh: 阿藍答兒問：「而父安在？」
units.en: Alamdar asked, "Where is your father?"
units.literal: Alamdar asked: "Where is your father?"

units.zh: 希亮曰：「不知，與吾父同任事者宜知之。」
units.en: Xiliang replied, "I do not know. Those who served with my father should know."
units.literal: Xiliang said: "I do not know; those who served together with my father ought to know."

units.zh: 渾都海怒，詬曰：「我焉得知之，其父今亡命東見皇帝矣！」
units.en: Hunduhai flew into a rage and shouted, "How should I know? His father has already fled east to pay court to the emperor!"
units.literal: Hunduhai grew angry and reviled him, saying: "How should I know? His father has now fled east to see the Emperor!"

units.zh: 希亮曰：「若然，則何謂不知！」
units.en: Xiliang said, "If that is so, what do you mean by saying you do not know!"
units.literal: Xiliang said: "If that is so, then what do you mean by not knowing!"

units.zh: 阿藍答兒熟視渾都海曰：「此言深有意焉。」
units.en: Alamdar fixed a long look on Hunduhai and said, "Those words carry a pointed meaning."
units.literal: Alamdar stared intently at Hunduhai and said: "These words carry deep meaning."

units.zh: 詰希亮甚急。
units.en: He pressed Xiliang hard for an answer.
units.literal: He pressed Xiliang very sharply.

units.zh: 希亮曰：「使吾知之，亦從而去，安得獨留！」
units.en: Xiliang said, "If I had known, I would have gone with him. How could I have been left behind alone!"
units.literal: Xiliang said: "Had I known, I would have gone away with him too—how could I alone have been left behind!"

units.zh: 阿藍答兒以為實，免其監蒞。
units.en: Alamdar accepted this as the truth and lifted the close guard over him.
units.literal: Alamdar took this as truth and released him from close guard.

units.zh: 既而阿藍答兒、渾都海為大兵所殺，其殘卒北走，眾推哈剌不花為帥。
units.en: Before long Alamdar and Hunduhai were killed by Kublai's main forces. The survivors fled north and chose Hala Buqa as their leader.
units.literal: Before long Alamdar and Hunduhai were killed by the main army; their remnant troops fled north, and the multitude made Hala Buqa commander.

units.zh: 希亮潛匿甘州北黑水東沙陀中。
units.en: Xiliang went into hiding in the Shatuo country east of the Black River, north of Ganzhou.
units.literal: Xiliang hid secretly in the Shatuo east of the Black Water north of Ganzhou.

units.zh: 殿兵已過十餘里，有尋馬者適至，老婢漏言，眾奄至，驅至肅州。
units.en: The rearguard had already marched more than ten li on when men sent to find horses arrived. An old servant woman let the secret slip, the pursuers fell upon them at once, and they were driven to Suzhou.
units.literal: The rearguard had already passed more than ten li when horse-seekers happened to arrive; an old maidservant let slip word, the crowd suddenly came upon them, and they were driven to Suzhou.

units.zh: 哈剌不花與鑄有婚姻之好，又哈剌不花在蜀時，嘗疾病，鑄召醫視之,遺以酒食， 因釋希亮縛，謂曰：「我受恩於汝父，此圖報之秋也。」
units.en: Hala Buqa was related to Zhu by marriage, and when Hala Buqa had fallen ill in Shu, Zhu had sent a physician and provisions. He now released Xiliang from his bonds and said, "Your father once showed me kindness. This is my chance to repay it."
units.literal: Hala Buqa and Zhu were joined by marriage ties; moreover, when Hala Buqa had been ill in Shu, Zhu summoned a physician to treat him and sent wine and food. He therefore released Xiliang's bonds and said: "I received favor from your father—this is the season to repay it."

units.zh: 及抵沙州北川，希亮與兄弟徒步負任，不火食者數日。
units.en: When they reached the northern reaches of Shazhou, Xiliang and his brothers went on foot carrying their loads and went several days without a cooked meal.
units.literal: When they reached the north stream of Shazhou, Xiliang and his brothers went on foot carrying burdens and went several days without cooked food.

units.zh: 是冬，涉雪逾天山，至北庭都護府。
units.en: That winter they crossed the snow-covered Tianshan and reached Beiting.
units.literal: That winter they crossed snow over the Tianshan and reached the Protectorate General of Beiting.

units.zh: 二年，至昌八里城。
units.en: In the second year they came to Changbali.
units.literal: In the second year they reached Changbali City.

units.zh: 夏，逾馬納思河，抵葉密里城，乃定宗潛邸湯沐之邑也。
units.en: In summer they crossed the Manasi River and reached Yemili, the appanage town of Güyük before he became khan.
units.literal: In summer they crossed the Manasi River and reached Yemili City—the fief granted for the maintenance of Emperor Dingzong when he was heir apparent.

units.zh: 時六皇后之妹主後位，與宗王火忽皆欲東覲。
units.en: The Sixth Empress Dowager's younger sister then held the empress's position, and she and Prince Huohu both wished to travel east to pay homage at court.
units.literal: At that time the younger sister of the Sixth Empress Dowager held the rear palace, and she and the prince Huohu both wished to go east to pay court.

units.zh: 希亮母密知其事，攜希亮入見，已而事不果。
units.en: Xiliang's mother learned of the plan in secret and brought Xiliang to an audience, but in the end nothing came of it.
units.literal: Xiliang's mother secretly learned of the matter, took Xiliang in to see her, but in the end the plan did not succeed.

units.zh: 冬，至於火孛之地。
units.en: In winter they reached the Huobie region.
units.literal: In winter they reached the land of Huobie.

units.zh: 三年，定宗幼子大名王閔其不能歸，遺以幣帛鞍馬，乃從大名王至忽只兒之地。
units.en: In the third year Prince Daming, Güyük's youngest son, took pity on his inability to return home and gave him silks, saddles, and horses. Xiliang then followed the prince to Huzhier.
units.literal: In the third year, Daming Wang, the young son of Emperor Dingzong, pitying that he could not return home, gave him silks, cloth, saddles, and horses; he then followed Daming Wang to the land of Huzhier.

units.zh: 會宗王阿魯忽至，誅阿里不哥所用鎮守之人唆羅海，欲附世祖。
units.en: Prince Alughu then arrived, executed Suoluohai, Ariq Böke's garrison commander, and declared his intent to join Kublai.
units.literal: When Prince Alughu arrived, he executed Suoluohai, whom Ariq Böke had placed in charge of the garrison, wishing to attach himself to the Shizu Emperor.

units.zh: 復從大名王及阿魯忽二王還至葉密里城。
units.en: He again followed Princes Daming and Alughu back to Yemili.
units.literal: He again followed the two princes Daming Wang and Alughu back to Yemili City.

units.zh: 王遺以耳環，其二珠大如榛，實價直千金，欲穿其耳使帶之。
units.en: The prince gave him earrings set with pearls as large as hazelnuts, worth a thousand in gold, and wanted to pierce his ears so he could wear them.
units.literal: The prince gave him ear ornaments; their two pearls were as large as hazelnuts and truly worth a thousand in gold; he wished to pierce his ears to wear them.

units.zh: 希亮辭曰：「不敢因是以傷父母之遺體也。
units.en: Xiliang declined, saying, "I dare not mutilate the body my parents gave me for the sake of such a gift.
units.literal: Xiliang declined, saying: "I dare not for this reason injure the body my parents bequeathed to me.

units.zh: 且無功受賞，於禮尤不可。」
units.en: Besides, to accept reward without having earned it is utterly contrary to propriety."
units.literal: Moreover, to receive reward without merit is especially impermissible in ritual propriety."

units.zh: 王又解金束帶遺之，且曰：「系此，於遺體宜無傷。」
units.en: The prince then took off a gold belt and gave it to him, saying, "Wear this—it should not harm the body your parents gave you."
units.literal: The prince again undid a gold girdle and gave it to him, saying: "Fasten this—it ought not to harm the body bequeathed to you."

units.zh: 五月，又為阿里不哥兵所驅，西行千五百里，至孛劣撒里之地。
units.en: In the fifth month Ariq Böke's troops drove them west again for fifteen hundred li to Beliesali.
units.literal: In the fifth month they were again driven by Ariq Böke's troops, traveling west fifteen hundred li to the land of Beliesali.

units.zh: 六月，又西至換扎孫之地。
units.en: In the sixth month they pressed on west to Huanzhasun.
units.literal: In the sixth month they went west again to the land of Huanzhasun.

units.zh: 又從至不剌城。
units.en: They continued on to Bula.
units.literal: They again followed on to Bula City.

units.zh: 又西行六百里，至徹徹里澤剌之山，后妃輜重皆留於此，希亮母及兄弟亦在焉。
units.en: They marched another six hundred li west to Checheli Zelazhi Mountain, where the empresses' baggage was left behind, along with Xiliang's mother and brothers.
units.literal: They again went west six hundred li to Checheli Zelazhi Mountain; the empresses' and consorts' baggage trains were all left here, and Xiliang's mother and brothers were also there.

units.zh: 希亮單騎從行二百餘里，至出布兒城。
units.en: Xiliang rode on alone for more than two hundred li to Chubuer.
units.literal: Xiliang alone on horseback followed the march more than two hundred li to Chubuer City.

units.zh: 又百里，至也裡虔城，而哈剌不花之兵奄至，希亮又從二王興師，還至不剌城，與哈剌不花戰，敗之，盡殲其眾。
units.en: Another hundred li brought them to Yeliqian, where Hala Buqa's army fell upon them. Xiliang again followed the two princes as they raised troops, marched back to Bula, routed Hala Buqa, and destroyed his force to the last man.
units.literal: Another hundred li on, they reached Yeliqian City, when Hala Buqa's troops suddenly arrived; Xiliang again followed the two princes in raising troops, returned to Bula City, fought Hala Buqa, defeated him, and annihilated his entire force.

units.zh: 二王乃函其頭，遣使報捷。
units.en: The two princes sent his head in a box to court with a dispatch announcing their victory.
units.literal: The two princes then boxed his head and sent envoys to report the victory.

units.zh: 十月，至於亦思寬之地。
units.en: In the tenth month they reached Yisikuan.
units.literal: In the tenth month they reached the land of Yisikuan.

units.zh: 四年，至可失哈里城。
units.en: In the fourth year they came to Keshihali.
units.literal: In the fourth year they reached Keshihali City.

units.zh: 四月，阿里不哥兵復至，希亮又從征，至渾八升城。
units.en: In the fourth month Ariq Böke's army returned, and Xiliang again joined the campaign as far as Hunbasheng.
units.literal: In the fourth month Ariq Böke's troops came again; Xiliang again followed the campaign to Hunbasheng City.

units.zh: 時希亮母從後避暑於阿體八升山。
units.en: Meanwhile his mother followed in the rear to spend the summer at Atibasheng Mountain.
units.literal: At that time Xiliang's mother followed in the rear to escape the heat at Atibasheng Mountain.

units.zh: 先是，鑄嘗言於世祖：「臣之妻子皆在北邊。」
units.en: Earlier Zhu had told Kublai, "My wife and children are all still in the north."
units.literal: Earlier Zhu had once said to the Shizu Emperor: "Your servant's wife and children are all in the north."

units.zh: 至是，世祖遣不華出至二王所，因以璽書召希亮，馳驛赴闕。
units.en: At this point Kublai sent Buhua to the two princes with an imperial summons for Xiliang, who raced by relay post to court.
units.literal: Now the Shizu Emperor sent Buhua out to where the two princes were and, by imperial sealed letter, summoned Xiliang, who sped by post relay to court.

units.zh: 六月，由苦先城至哈剌火州，出伊州，涉大漠以還。
units.en: In the sixth month he went from Kuxian to Karahuozhou, passed through Yizhou, and crossed the great desert on his way home.
units.literal: In the sixth month, from Kuxian City to Karahuozhou, out through Yizhou, crossing the great desert to return.

units.zh: 八月，入覲世祖於上都之大安閣，備陳邊事，及羈旅困苦之狀。
units.en: In the eighth month he had audience with Kublai in the Da'an Pavilion at Shangdu, where he gave a full account of frontier affairs and the hardships of his years in exile.
units.literal: In the eighth month he entered audience with the Shizu Emperor at the Da'an Pavilion in Shangdu, fully setting forth border affairs and the hardships of his long exile.

units.zh: 世祖憐之，賜鈔千錠、金帶一、幣帛三十，命為速古兒赤、必阇赤。
units.en: Kublai took pity on him, gave him a thousand ingots of paper money, a gold belt, and thirty lengths of silk, and appointed him suguerchi and bichechi.
units.literal: The Shizu Emperor pitied him, bestowed a thousand ingots of paper money, one gold belt, and thirty pieces of silks and cloth, and appointed him suguerchi and bichechi.

units.zh: 至元八年，授奉訓大夫、符寶郎。
units.en: In the eighth year of the Zhiyuan reign he was made Fengxun dafu and keeper of the imperial seals.
units.literal: In the eighth year of Zhiyuan he was appointed Fengxun dafu and Fubao lang.

units.zh: 十二年，既平宋，世祖命希亮問諸降將，日本可伐否。
units.en: In the twelfth year, after the conquest of the Song, Kublai had Xiliang poll the surrendered generals on whether Japan could be invaded.
units.literal: In the twelfth year, after the Song had been pacified, the Shizu Emperor ordered Xiliang to ask the surrendered generals whether Japan could be attacked.

units.zh: 夏貴、呂文煥、範文虎、陳奕等皆云可伐。
units.en: Xia Gui, Lü Wenhuan, Fan Wenhu, Chen Yi, and the others all said it could be done.
units.literal: Xia Gui, Lü Wenhuan, Fan Wenhu, Chen Yi, and the others all said it could be attacked.

units.zh: 希亮奏曰：「宋與遼、金攻戰且三百年，干戈甫定，人得息肩，俟數年，興師未晚。」
units.en: Xiliang submitted, "The Song had been at war with Liao and Jin for nearly three hundred years. Arms have only just been stilled and the people have barely caught their breath. Wait a few years before launching another campaign—it will not be too late."
units.literal: Xiliang memorialized: "The Song fought with Liao and Jin for nearly three hundred years; arms have only just been laid down and the people have barely rested their shoulders—wait a few years, and raising troops will not be too late."

units.zh: 世祖然之。
units.en: The emperor agreed.
units.literal: The Shizu Emperor approved this.

units.zh: 十三年，太府監令史盧贄言於監官：「各路所貢布長三丈，唯平陽加一丈，諸怯薛歹以故爭取平陽布。
units.en: In the thirteenth year the Taifu Directorate clerk Lu Zan told his supervisor, "Each circuit's tribute cloth is three zhang long, but Pingyang's is one zhang longer, so the imperial guards all scramble for Pingyang cloth.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year, the Taifu Directorate clerk Lu Zan said to the supervising official: "The cloth presented from each circuit is three zhang in length; only Pingyang adds one zhang, and for this reason the keshik all vie for Pingyang cloth.

units.zh: 苟截其長者，與他郡等，則無所爭，而以其所截者為髹漆宮殿器皿之用，甚便。」
units.en: If we trim the extra length to match the other prefectures, there will be no dispute, and the trimmed pieces can be used for lacquered palace furnishings—a very practical arrangement."
units.literal: If the excess length were cut off to make it equal to other prefectures, there would be no contention, and the cut portions could be used for lacquered palace vessels—very convenient."

units.zh: 監官從之。
units.en: The supervisor agreed.
units.literal: The supervising official followed this advice.

units.zh: 適左右以其事聞，帝以詰監官，監官倉皇莫知所以對，歸罪於贄，帝命斬之。
units.en: Attendants soon reported the matter to the emperor, who questioned the supervisor. Flustered and unable to answer, the supervisor blamed Zan, and the emperor ordered Zan executed.
units.literal: Just then attendants reported the matter to the emperor, who questioned the supervising official; the official, in panic, did not know how to answer and shifted blame onto Zan; the emperor ordered Zan beheaded.

units.zh: 希亮遇諸塗，贄以寃告。
units.en: Xiliang met him on the road, and Zan pleaded that he had been wronged.
units.literal: Xiliang met him on the road, and Zan pleaded his wrongful case.

units.zh: 希亮命少緩，具以實入奏。
units.en: Xiliang asked that execution be delayed and submitted a full report of what had actually happened.
units.literal: Xiliang ordered a brief delay and entered a full report of the facts.

units.zh: 有旨令董文用讞之。
units.en: The emperor ordered Dong Wenyong to review the case.
units.literal: An edict ordered Dong Wenyong to judge the case.

units.zh: 竟釋贄，而召御史大夫塔察兒等讓之曰：「此事言官當言而不言，向微禿忽思，不誤誅此人耶！」
units.en: Zan was released in the end, and the censor-in-chief Tachar and others were summoned and rebuked: "The remonstrating officials should have spoken up on this. Had it not been for Tuhusi, would we not have executed an innocent man!"
units.literal: In the end Zan was released, and the Censor-in-Chief Tachar and others were summoned and rebuked: "On this matter the remonstrating officials ought to have spoken but did not—had it not been for Tuhusi, would this man not have been wrongly executed!"

units.zh: 十四年，轉嘉議大夫、禮部尚書，尋遷吏部尚書。
units.en: In the fourteenth year he was promoted to Jiayi dafu and Minister of Rites, and soon afterward became Minister of Personnel.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year he was transferred to Jiayi dafu and Minister of Rites, and soon moved to Minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 帝駐蹕察納兒台之地，希亮至，奏對畢，董文用問大都近事。
units.en: While the emperor was encamped at Chanaiertai, Xiliang had audience and afterward Dong Wenyong asked him about recent affairs in the capital.
units.literal: The emperor was encamped at Chanaiertai; when Xiliang arrived and finished his audience, Dong Wenyong asked about recent affairs in Dadu.

units.zh: 希亮曰：「囹圄多囚耳。」
units.en: Xiliang said, "The prisons are simply overcrowded."
units.literal: Xiliang said: "The prisons hold many prisoners, that is all."

units.zh: 世祖方欹枕而臥，忽寤，問其故。
units.en: Kublai had been dozing on his pillow; he started awake and asked why.
units.literal: The Shizu Emperor had been reclining on his pillow; he suddenly woke and asked the reason.

units.zh: 希亮奏曰：「近奉旨：漢人盜鈔六文者殺。
units.en: Xiliang said, "A recent order decreed that any Han person who steals six cash in paper money is to be executed.
units.literal: Xiliang memorialized: "Recently there was an order: Han people who steal six cash in paper money are to be killed.

units.zh: 以是囚多。」
units.en: That is why the prisons are so full."
units.literal: Because of this the prisoners are many."

units.zh: 帝驚問：「孰傳此語？」
units.en: The emperor asked in alarm, "Who spread such an order?"
units.literal: The emperor asked in alarm: "Who transmitted these words?"

units.zh: 省臣曰：「此旨實脫兒察所傳。」
units.en: The Secretariat officials said, "It was Toercha who transmitted it."
units.literal: The provincial officials said: "This order was in fact transmitted by Toercha."

units.zh: 脫兒察曰：「陛下在南坡，以語蒙古兒童。」
units.en: Toercha said, "Your Majesty said this in jest to some Mongol boys at Nanpo."
units.literal: Toercha said: "Your Majesty, at Nanpo, spoke thus to Mongol children."

units.zh: 帝曰：「前言戲耳，曷嘗著為令式？」
units.en: The emperor said, "That was only a joke. When did I ever turn it into law?"
units.literal: The emperor said: "Those words were spoken in jest—when were they ever made a formal statute?"

units.zh: 乃罪脫兒察。
units.en: He then punished Toercha.
units.literal: He then punished Toercha.

units.zh: 希亮因奏曰：「令既出矣，必明其錯誤，以安民心。」
units.en: Xiliang then said, "Since the order has already gone out, its error must be publicly acknowledged to set the people's minds at ease."
units.literal: Xiliang then memorialized: "Since the order has already gone forth, its error must be made clear to reassure the people's hearts."

units.zh: 帝善其言，即命希亮至大都，諭旨中書。
units.en: The emperor approved and immediately sent Xiliang to Dadu to announce the correction to the Central Secretariat.
units.literal: The emperor approved his words and at once ordered Xiliang to go to Dadu and proclaim the imperial intent to the Central Secretariat.

units.zh: 十七年，希亮以跋涉西土，足病痿攣，謝事而去，退居惣陽者二十餘年。
units.en: In the seventeenth year, worn out by his years in the western regions, Xiliang developed crippling paralysis in his legs. He resigned and lived in retirement at Zongyang for more than twenty years.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year, because of his long journey through the western lands Xiliang's feet were afflicted with flaccid paralysis; he resigned his office and withdrew, living in retirement at Zongyang for more than twenty years.

units.zh: 至大二年，武宗訪求先朝舊臣，特除翰林學士承旨、資善大夫，尋改授翰林學士承旨、知制誥兼修國史。
units.en: In the second year of the Zhida reign, Emperor Wuzong sought out veterans of the previous reign and specially appointed him Hanlin expositor-in-chief and Zishan dafu; he was soon given the additional posts of drafter of edicts and compiler of the national history.
units.literal: In the second year of Zhida, Emperor Wuzong sought out old ministers of the previous reign and specially appointed him Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief and Zishan dafu; soon he was reassigned Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief, Drafter of Imperial Edicts, and Compiler of National History.

units.zh: 希亮以職在史官，乃類次世祖嘉言善行以進，英宗取其書，置禁中。
units.en: In his capacity as historiographer, Xiliang compiled Kublai's memorable sayings and worthy deeds and presented them to the throne. Emperor Yingzong took the work into the inner palace.
units.literal: Because his office was among the historiographers, Xiliang arranged by category the Shizu Emperor's fine words and good deeds and presented them; Emperor Yingzong took the book and placed it in the inner palace.

units.zh: 久之，閒居京師，四方之士多從之遊。
units.en: After a time he lived quietly in the capital, and scholars from all directions came to study with him.
units.literal: After a long while he lived at leisure in the capital, and scholars from all quarters often associated with him.

units.zh: 泰定四年卒，年八十一。
units.en: He died in the fourth year of the Taiding reign, at the age of eighty-one.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Taiding he died, aged eighty-one.

units.zh: 希亮性至孝，困厄遐方，家貲散亡已盡，僅藏祖考畫像，四時就穹廬陳列致奠，盡誠盡敬。
units.en: Xiliang was profoundly filial. During his hardships in distant lands the family fortune was lost entirely; he kept only portraits of his ancestors and, at each season, set them out in his yurt to offer sacrifice with complete devotion.
units.literal: Xiliang's nature was supremely filial; in hardship in distant lands the family wealth was utterly dispersed, and he kept only portraits of his ancestors and forebears; at the four seasons he set them out in the yurt to offer sacrifice with utmost sincerity and respect.

units.zh: 朔漠之人，咸相聚來觀，歎曰：「此中土之禮也。」
units.en: People of the northern steppe gathered to watch and marveled, "This is the ritual of China proper."
units.literal: The people of the northern deserts all gathered to come and watch, sighing: "This is the ritual of the Central Plains."

units.zh: 雖疾病，不廢書史，或中夜起坐，取燭以書。
units.en: Even when ill he never set aside his books; sometimes he would rise in the middle of the night, light a candle, and write.
units.literal: Even when ill he did not abandon books and histories; sometimes in the middle of the night he would rise, take a candle, and write.

units.zh: 所著詩文及從軍紀行錄三十卷，目之曰《愫軒集》。
units.en: His collected poems, essays, and military campaign diary in thirty juan he entitled the "Suoxuan Collection."
units.literal: His collected poems and prose and record of campaigning in thirty juan he titled the "Suoxuan ji".

units.zh: 贈推忠輔義守正功臣、資善大夫、集賢學士、上護軍，追封漆水郡公，諡忠嘉。
units.en: He was posthumously honored as Meritorious Minister Who Promotes Loyalty, Supports Righteousness, and Upholds Integrity, Zishan dafu, Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, and Superior Guardian of the Army; enfeoffed as Duke of Qishui Commandery with the posthumous name Zhongjia.
units.literal: He was posthumously granted the title Meritorious Minister Who Promotes Loyalty, Supports Righteousness, and Upholds Integrity, Zishan dafu, Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, and Superior Guardian of the Army; enfeoffed as Duke of Qishui Commandery; posthumous name Zhongjia.

units.zh: 趙世延
units.en: Zhao Shiyan
units.literal: Zhao Shiyan

units.zh: 趙世延，字子敬，其先雍古族人，居雲中北邊。
units.en: Zhao Shiyan, whose style name was Zijing, was descended from the Yonggu people and came from the northern frontier of Yunzhong.
units.literal: Zhao Shiyan, styled Zijing, was by ancestry of the Yonggu tribe and lived on the northern border of Yunzhong.

units.zh: 曾祖公，為金群牧使，太祖得其所牧馬，公死之。
units.en: His great-grandfather Gong had been the Jin director of imperial herds. When Genghis Khan seized the horses under his charge, Gong died resisting.
units.literal: His great-grandfather Gong was Jin Director of Herds; when Taizu obtained the horses he pastured, Gong died for it.

units.zh: 祖按竺邇，幼孤，鞠於外大父術要甲，訛為趙家，因氏為趙；
units.en: His grandfather Anzhuer was orphaned young and raised by his maternal grandfather Shuyao Jia; the name was corrupted to Zhao, and he adopted Zhao as his surname.
units.literal: His grandfather Anzhuer was orphaned young, reared by his maternal grandfather Shuyao Jia; misheard as the Zhao family, he therefore took Zhao as his surname;

units.zh: 驍勇善騎射，從太祖征伐，有功，為蒙古漢軍徵行大元帥，鎮蜀，因家成都。
units.en: Brave and skilled in horsemanship and archery, he followed Genghis Khan on campaign, won distinction, became grand marshal on campaign of the Mongol Han army, guarded Shu, and settled his family in Chengdu.
units.literal: valiant and skilled in riding and archery, he followed Taizu on campaigns, had merit, became Grand Marshal on Campaign of the Mongol Han Army, guarded Shu, and made his home in Chengdu.

units.zh: 父黑梓，以門功襲父元帥職，兼文州吐蕃萬戶府達魯花赤。
units.en: His father Heizi inherited the marshal's post through hereditary service and also held the post of darughachi of the Wenzhou Tubo Ten-thousand Households Office.
units.literal: His father Heizi, by hereditary merit inherited his father's post as marshal and concurrently served as darughachi of the Wenzou Tubo Ten-thousand Households Office.

units.zh: 世延天資秀發，喜讀書，究心儒者體用之學。
units.en: Shiyan was gifted by nature, loved books, and devoted himself to the Confucian study of principle and practical application.
units.literal: Shiyan's natural endowment was brilliant; he delighted in reading books and devoted himself to the Confucian learning of substance and function.

units.zh: 弱冠，世祖召見，俾入樞密院御史臺肄習官政。
units.en: At his coming of age, Kublai received him in audience and had him train in government at the Bureau of Military Affairs and the Censorate.
units.literal: At the capping age the Shizu Emperor summoned him for audience and had him enter the Bureau of Military Affairs and the Censorate to practice official administration.

units.zh: 至元二十一年，授承事郎、雲南諸路提刑按察司判官，時年二十有四。
units.en: In the twenty-first year of the Zhiyuan reign he was made Chengshi lang and judge of the Yunnan Circuit Surveillance Commission, at the age of twenty-four.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year of Zhiyuan he was appointed Chengshi lang and investigating censorial judge of the Yunnan Circuit Surveillance Commission, aged twenty-four.

units.zh: 烏蒙蠻酋叛，世延會省臣以軍討之，蠻兵大潰，即請降。
units.en: When the Wumeng chieftain rebelled, Shiyan joined the provincial officials in a punitive campaign, routed the tribesmen, and accepted their immediate surrender.
units.literal: The Wumeng tribal chief rebelled; Shiyan joined the provincial officials in leading troops to attack; the tribal troops were utterly routed and at once sought surrender.

units.zh: 二十六年，擢監察御史，與同列五人劾丞相桑哥不法。
units.en: In the twenty-sixth year he was promoted to investigating censor and, together with five colleagues, impeached Chancellor Sangge for misconduct.
units.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he was promoted investigating censor and, with five colleagues, impeached the chancellor Sangge for unlawful conduct.

units.zh: 中丞趙國輔，桑哥黨也，抑不以聞，更以告桑哥。
units.en: Vice censor-in-chief Zhao Guofu, a partisan of Sangge, suppressed the memorial and reported it to Sangge instead.
units.literal: The vice censor-in-chief Zhao Guofu, a member of Sangge's faction, suppressed the report and instead informed Sangge.

units.zh: 於是五人者悉為其所擠，而世延獨倖免。
units.en: All five of his colleagues were driven from office, but Shiyan alone escaped retribution.
units.literal: Thereupon all five men were squeezed out by him, while Shiyan alone escaped harm.

units.zh: 奉旨按平陽郡監也先忽都贓巨萬，鞫左司郎中董仲威殺人獄，皆明允。
units.en: By imperial order he investigated the Pingyang supervisor Yexian Hudu for embezzling a fortune and tried Left Department Director Dong Zhongwei for murder; in both cases his judgments were fair and clear.
units.literal: By imperial order he investigated Supervisor Yexian Hudu of Pingyang Commandery for embezzling tens of thousands, and tried the case of Left Department Director Dong Zhongwei for murder—all were clearly adjudicated.

units.zh: 二十九年，轉奉議大夫，出僉江南湖北道肅政廉訪司事。
units.en: In the twenty-ninth year he was made Fengyi dafu and dispatched as administrator of the Jiangnan Hubei Circuit Surveillance Commission.
units.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he was transferred to Fengyi dafu and sent out as administrator of the Jiangnan Hubei Circuit Surveillance Commission.

units.zh: 敦儒學，立義倉，撤淫祠，修澧陽縣壞堤，嚴常、澧掠賣良民之禁，部內晏然。
units.en: He encouraged Confucian learning, founded charity granaries, abolished illicit shrines, repaired the broken dike at Liyang, and strictly forbade the kidnapping and sale of commoners in Chang and Li; his jurisdiction became notably peaceful.
units.literal: He promoted Confucian learning, established charity granaries, abolished illicit shrines, repaired the broken dike at Liyang County, and strictly forbade the abduction and sale of commoners in Chang and Li—within his jurisdiction all was tranquil.

units.zh: 元貞元年，除江南行御史臺都事，丁內艱，不赴。
units.en: In the first year of the Yuanzhen reign he was appointed secretary of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate but declined the post to observe mourning for his mother.
units.literal: In the first year of Yuanzhen he was appointed secretary of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate but, mourning his mother, did not take up the post.

units.zh: 大德元年，复除前官。
units.en: In the first year of the Dade reign he was reappointed to the same office.
units.literal: In the first year of Dade he was again appointed to his former office.

units.zh: 三年，移中臺都事，俄改中書左司都事。
units.en: In the third year he became secretary of the Central Branch Censorate and soon afterward secretary of the Left Department of the Central Secretariat.
units.literal: In the third year he was moved to secretary of the Central Branch Censorate and soon changed to secretary of the Left Department of the Central Secretariat.

units.zh: 臺臣奏，仍為都事中臺。
units.en: The censors memorialized, and he was returned to his post as secretary of the Central Branch Censorate.
units.literal: The censorial officials memorialized, and he again became secretary of the Central Branch Censorate.

units.zh: 六年，由山東肅政廉訪副使改江南行臺治書侍御史。
units.en: In the sixth year he was transferred from vice commissioner of the Shandong Surveillance Commission to supervising secretary of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate.
units.literal: In the sixth year, from vice commissioner of the Shandong Surveillance Commission he was changed to supervising secretary of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate.

units.zh: 十年，除安西路總管。
units.en: In the tenth year he was appointed prefect of Anxi Circuit.
units.literal: In the tenth year he was appointed prefect of Anxi Circuit.

units.zh: 安西，故京兆省臺所治，號稱會府，前政壅滯者三千牘。
units.en: Anxi had formerly been administered by the Jingzhao provincial government and censorate and was known as a metropolitan prefecture; three thousand cases had piled up under the previous administration.
units.literal: Anxi was formerly governed by the Jingzhao provincial government and censorate, styled a metropolitan prefecture; the previous administration had a backlog of three thousand cases.

units.zh: 世延既至，不三月，剖決殆盡。
units.en: Within three months of Shiyan's arrival he had disposed of nearly all of them.
units.literal: After Shiyan arrived, within three months he had judged them nearly all.

units.zh: 陝民飢，省臺議請於朝賑之，世延曰：「救荒如救火，願先發廩以賑，朝廷設不允，世延當傾家財若身以償。」
units.en: When famine struck Shaan, the provincial authorities debated asking the court for relief. Shiyan said, "Famine relief is like fighting a fire. Let me open the granaries at once; if the court refuses, I will repay the cost from my own estate and person."
units.literal: The people of Shaan were starving; the provincial government and censorate discussed requesting relief from court; Shiyan said: "Famine relief is like putting out a fire—I wish to open the granaries first to relieve the people; if the court should not approve, Shiyan will repay with his family wealth and even his person."

units.zh: 省臺從之，所活者眾。
units.en: The provincial authorities agreed, and a great many lives were saved.
units.literal: The provincial government and censorate followed this, and those who were saved were many.

units.zh: 至大元年，除紹興路總管，改四川肅政廉訪使。
units.en: In the first year of the Zhida reign he was made prefect of Shaoxing and then commissioner of the Sichuan Surveillance Commission.
units.literal: In the first year of Zhida he was appointed prefect of Shaoxing Circuit and changed to commissioner of the Sichuan Surveillance Commission.

units.zh: 蒙古軍士，科差繁重，而軍士就戍往來者多害人，且軍官或抑良為奴，世延皆除其弊而正其罪。
units.en: Mongol soldiers bore crushing tax levies, and troops traveling to and from garrison duty often preyed on civilians; some officers even forced commoners into slavery. Shiyan eliminated these abuses and punished the offenders.
units.literal: Mongol soldiers' tax levies were heavy, and soldiers going to and from garrison duty often harmed the people; moreover officers sometimes forced commoners into slavery—Shiyan removed all these abuses and punished the guilty.

units.zh: 又修都江堰，民尤便之。
units.en: He also repaired the Dujiangyan irrigation works, to the people's great benefit.
units.literal: He also repaired the Dujiangyan works, to the people's great convenience.

units.zh: 四年，升中奉大夫、陝西行臺侍御史。
units.en: In the fourth year he was promoted to Zhongfeng dafu and attendant censor of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate.
units.literal: In the fourth year he was promoted to Zhongfeng dafu and attendant censor of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate.

units.zh: 先是，八百媳婦為邊患，右丞劉深往討之，兵敗而還，坐罪棄市。
units.en: Earlier the Babai Xifu had troubled the frontier; Right Chancellor Liu Shen led a campaign against them, was defeated, returned, and was executed for his failure.
units.literal: Earlier, the Babai Xifu had been a border menace; the right chancellor Liu Shen went to attack them, was defeated and returned, and was executed for the crime.

units.zh: 及是，右丞阿忽台當繼行，世延言：「蠻夷事在羈縻，而重煩天討，致軍旅亡失，誅戮省臣，藉使盡得其地，何補於國？
units.en: When Right Chancellor Ahu Tai was to take over the campaign, Shiyan said, "Barbarian affairs call for loose reins, not repeated imperial expeditions that cost armies and officials' lives. Even if we took all their land, what would the state gain?
units.literal: At this time Right Chancellor Ahu Tai was to succeed him on the campaign; Shiyan said: "Barbarian affairs are a matter of loose reins; yet we repeatedly trouble the Son of Heaven with punitive expeditions, causing armies to be lost and provincial ministers executed—even if we gained all their land, what would it profit the state?

units.zh: 今窮兵黷武，實傷聖治。
units.en: This endless warfare truly harms the emperor's wise rule.
units.literal: Now exhausting the armies in ceaseless warfare truly injures sagely governance.

units.zh: 朝廷第當選重臣知治體者，付以邊寄，兵宜止勿用。」
units.en: The court should appoint seasoned ministers who understand governance to manage the frontier and halt the use of troops."
units.literal: The court should only select weighty ministers who understand governance and entrust them with frontier affairs; troops should be halted and not used."

units.zh: 事聞，樞密院臣以為用兵國家大事，不宜以一人之言為興輟。
units.en: When the memorial reached court, the Bureau of Military Affairs argued that war is a matter of state and should not be decided by one man's opinion.
units.literal: When the matter was reported, the Bureau of Military Affairs officials held that using troops is a great affair of state and should not be launched or halted on one man's words.

units.zh: 世延聞之，章再上，事卒罷。
units.en: Shiyan heard of this and memorialized again; in the end the campaign was called off.
units.literal: When Shiyan heard this, he memorialized again; in the end the affair was abandoned.

units.zh: 皇慶二年，拜江浙行省參知政事，尋召還，拜侍御史。
units.en: In the second year of the Huangqing reign he was made vice administrator of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, soon recalled, and appointed attendant censor.
units.literal: In the second year of Huangqing he was appointed vice administrator of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat; soon recalled and appointed attendant censor.

units.zh: 延祐元年，省臣奏：「比奉詔漢人參政用儒者，趙世延其人也。」
units.en: In the first year of the Yanyou reign the provincial officials memorialized, "By the recent edict that Han vice administrators should be Confucians, Zhao Shiyan is the man."
units.literal: In the first year of Yanyou the provincial officials memorialized: "In accordance with the recent edict that Han vice administrators should be Confucians, Zhao Shiyan is such a man."

units.zh: 帝曰：「世延誠可用，然雍古氏非漢人，其署宜居右。」
units.en: The emperor said, "Shiyan is indeed fit for office, but the Yonggu are not Han Chinese; his appointment should be listed on the right."
units.literal: The emperor said: "Shiyan is indeed usable, but the Yonggu are not Han; his title should be placed on the right."

units.zh: 遂拜中書參知政事。
units.en: He was then appointed vice administrator of the Central Secretariat.
units.literal: He was then appointed vice administrator of the Central Secretariat.

units.zh: 居中書二十月，遷御史中丞。
units.en: After twenty months in the Secretariat he was made censor-in-chief.
units.literal: After twenty months in the Secretariat he was transferred to censor-in-chief.

units.zh: 有旨省臣自平章以下，率送之官。
units.en: An edict required that all Secretariat officials from the pingzhang down escort him to his new post.
units.literal: There was an order that Secretariat officials from the pingzhang down should all escort him to office.

units.zh: 其禮前所無有，由是為權臣所忌，乃用皇太后旨，出世延為雲南行省右丞。
units.en: No such ceremony had existed before. Powerful ministers resented him for it and used an empress dowager's order to send him out as right chancellor of the Yunnan Branch Secretariat.
units.literal: This ceremony had never existed before; because of this he was envied by powerful ministers, who used an order of the empress dowager to send Shiyan out as right chancellor of the Yunnan Branch Secretariat.

units.zh: 陛辭，帝特命仍還御史臺為中丞。
units.en: At his farewell audience the emperor specially ordered that he remain censor-in-chief at the Censorate.
units.literal: At his farewell audience the emperor specially ordered that he still return to the Censorate as censor-in-chief.

units.zh: 三年，世延劾奏權臣太師、右丞相帖木迭兒罪惡十有三，詔奪其官職。
units.en: In the third year Shiyan impeached the powerful minister Temuder, Grand Preceptor and Right Chancellor, on thirteen counts; an edict stripped him of office.
units.literal: In the third year Shiyan impeached the powerful minister, Grand Preceptor and Right Chancellor Temuder, listing thirteen crimes; an edict stripped him of his offices.

units.zh: 尋升翰林學士承旨，兼御史中丞，世延固辭，乃解中丞。
units.en: He was soon promoted to Hanlin Academician Recipient of Edicts while retaining the censor-in-chief post, but Shiyan firmly declined the latter and was relieved of it.
units.literal: Soon he was promoted Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief, concurrently censor-in-chief; Shiyan firmly declined and was relieved of the censorate post.

units.zh: 五年，進光祿大夫、昭文館學士，守大都留守，乞補外，拜四川行省平章政事。
units.en: In the fifth year he was made Guanglu dafu and Academician of the Zhaowen Hall, guardian of Dadu, requested an appointment outside the capital, and was made pingzhang of the Sichuan Branch Secretariat.
units.literal: In the fifth year he was advanced to Guanglu dafu and Academician of the Zhaowen Hall, guardian of the Dadu capital, begged an outer appointment, and was appointed pingzhang of the Sichuan Branch Secretariat.

units.zh: 世延議即重慶路立屯田，物色江津、巴縣閒田七百八十三頃，摘軍千二百人墾之，歲得粟萬一千七百石。
units.en: Shiyan proposed establishing military colonies in Chongqing, identified 783 qing of land between Jiangjin and Baxian, assigned 1,200 soldiers to farm it, and harvested 11,700 shi of grain a year.
units.literal: Shiyan proposed immediately establishing military colonies in Chongqing Circuit, located seven hundred eighty-three qing of fields between Jiangjin and Baxian, selected twelve hundred soldiers to cultivate them, and annually obtained eleven thousand seven hundred shi of grain.

units.zh: 明年，仁宗崩，帖木迭兒复居相位，銳意報復，屬其黨何志道，誘世延從弟胥益兒哈呼誣告世延罪，逮世延置對，至夔路，遇赦。
units.en: The following year Emperor Renzong died. Temuder returned to power bent on revenge and had his partisan He Zhidao induce Shiyan's cousin Xu Yierhahu to accuse him falsely. Shiyan was arrested and interrogated, reached Kuizhou, and was freed by amnesty.
units.literal: The next year Emperor Renzong died; Temuder again held the chancellorship and was intent on revenge; he assigned his partisan He Zhidao to induce Shiyan's younger cousin Xu Yierhahu to lodge a false accusation against Shiyan; Shiyan was arrested for interrogation, reached Kuizhou, and met an amnesty.

units.zh: 世延以疾抵荊門，留就醫。
units.en: Ill, Shiyan reached Jingmen and remained there for treatment.
units.literal: Shiyan, ill, reached Jingmen and stayed there for medical treatment.

units.zh: 帖木迭兒遣使督追至京師，俾其黨煅煉使成獄。
units.en: Temuder sent agents to hurry him to the capital and had his faction forge evidence to secure a conviction.
units.literal: Temuder sent envoys to urge pursuit to the capital and had his faction fabricate evidence to complete the case.

units.zh: 會有旨，事經赦原，勿復問。
units.en: An edict then arrived that matters covered by amnesty were not to be pursued further.
units.literal: Just then there was an order that matters covered by amnesty should not be pursued further.

units.zh: 帖木迭兒更以它事白帝，系之刑曹，逼令自裁，世延不為動，居囚再歲。
units.en: Temuder reported other charges to the emperor, had him imprisoned in the penal office, and pressed him to kill himself. Shiyan did not waver and spent two years in prison.
units.literal: Temuder again reported other matters to the emperor, had him imprisoned in the penal office, and pressed him to take his own life; Shiyan was unmoved and remained a prisoner for two years.

units.zh: 胥益兒哈呼自以所訴涉誣欺，亡去。
units.en: Xu Yierhahu, realizing his accusation was false, fled.
units.literal: Xu Yierhahu, believing his accusation involved falsehood and deceit, fled.

units.zh: 中書左丞相拜住屢言世延亡辜，得旨出獄，就舍以養疾。
units.en: Left Chancellor Bayiju repeatedly declared Shiyan innocent; an order released him from prison to recover at home.
units.literal: Left Chancellor Bayiju repeatedly said Shiyan was innocent; an order released Shiyan from prison to recuperate at his residence.

units.zh: 先是，帝獵北涼亭，顧謂侍臣曰：「趙世延先帝所尊禮，而帖木迭兒妄入其罪，數請誅之，此殆報私怨耳，朕豈能從之。」
units.en: Earlier, while hunting at Beiliang Pavilion, the emperor told his attendants, "Zhao Shiyan was honored by my predecessor, yet Temuder falsely accused him and repeatedly sought his execution. That was private revenge, and I would not consent."
units.literal: Earlier, while hunting at Beiliang Pavilion, the emperor looked back and said to his attendants: "Zhao Shiyan was honored by the late emperor, yet Temuder falsely charged him and repeatedly asked that he be executed—this is surely repaying a private grudge; how could I follow that?"

units.zh: 侍臣皆叩頭稱萬歲。
units.en: The attendants all kowtowed and shouted long life to the emperor.
units.literal: The attendants all kowtowed and shouted "Long live the Emperor!"

units.zh: 帖木迭兒在上京，聞世延出獄，索省牘視之，怒曰：「此左丞相罔上所為也。」
units.en: Temuder was at Shangdu. Learning that Shiyan had been released, he demanded the Secretariat records and said angrily, "The left chancellor deceived the sovereign in this."
units.literal: Temuder was at Shangdu; hearing that Shiyan had left prison, he demanded the Secretariat documents to inspect them and said angrily: "This was done by the left chancellor deceiving the sovereign."

units.zh: 事聞，帝語之曰：「此朕意耳。」
units.en: When this was reported, the emperor told him, "It was my decision."
units.literal: When the matter was reported, the emperor said to him: "This was my intention."

units.zh: 未幾，帖木迭兒死，事乃釋。
units.en: Before long Temuder died and the matter was closed.
units.literal: Before long Temuder died and the affair was concluded.

units.zh: 世延出居於金陵。
units.en: Shiyan retired to Jinling.
units.literal: Shiyan went out to live at Jinling.

units.zh: 泰定元年，召還朝，除集賢大學士。
units.en: In the first year of the Taiding reign he was recalled and made Grand Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies.
units.literal: In the first year of Taiding he was summoned back to court and appointed Grand Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies.

units.zh: 明年，出為江南行臺御史中丞。
units.en: The following year he was sent out as censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate.
units.literal: The next year he was sent out as censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate.

units.zh: 四年，入朝，復為御史中丞，又遷中書右丞。
units.en: In the fourth year he came to court, was again made censor-in-chief, and was promoted to right vice chancellor of the Secretariat.
units.literal: In the fourth year he entered court, again became censor-in-chief, and was further transferred to right vice chancellor of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 明年，有旨：趙世延頃為權奸所誣，中書宜遍移天下，昭雪其非辜，仍加翰林學士承旨、光祿大夫。
units.en: The next year an edict declared that Zhao Shiyan had been slandered by powerful traitors; the Central Secretariat was to notify the empire to clear his name, and he was further made Hanlin expositor-in-chief and Guanglu dafu.
units.literal: The next year there was an order: Zhao Shiyan was recently slandered by powerful traitors; the Central Secretariat should circulate the empire to clear his wrongful guilt, and he was further given Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief and Guanglu dafu.

units.zh: 經筵開，兼知經筵事，選揀勸講者，皆一時名流。
units.en: When the Classics Colloquium was established, he was placed in charge of it and chose lecturers from the foremost scholars of the day.
units.literal: When the Classics Colloquium opened, he was concurrently placed in charge of it; those selected as lecturers were all leading figures of the time.

units.zh: 又加同知樞密院事。
units.en: He was also made vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
units.literal: He was further made vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 泰定帝崩，燕鐵木兒與宗王大臣議：武宗二子周王、懷王，於法當立；
units.en: When Emperor Taiding died, El Temür and the princes and ministers deliberated: of Emperor Wuzong's two sons, the Zhou King and the Huai King were the lawful heirs;
units.literal: When Emperor Taiding died, El Temür and the princes and great ministers deliberated: of Emperor Wuzong's two sons, the Zhou King and the Huai King, by law they should be enthroned;

units.zh: 周王遠在朔漠，而懷王久居民間，備嘗艱險，民必歸之，天位不可久虛，不如先迎懷王，以從民望。
units.en: but the Zhou King was far away in the northern steppe while the Huai King had long lived among the people and borne every hardship. The people would surely rally to him, and the throne could not remain empty; they should welcome the Huai King first to satisfy public expectation.
units.literal: the Zhou King was far in the northern desert, while the Huai King had long lived among the people and fully tasted hardship—the people would surely turn to him; the throne could not long stand empty—it would be better first to welcome the Huai King to follow the people's hopes.

units.zh: 八月，即定策，迎之於江陵，懷王即位，是為文宗。
units.en: In the eighth month they settled the plan, welcomed him at Jiangling, and the Huai King ascended the throne as Emperor Wenzong.
units.literal: In the eighth month the decision was fixed; he was welcomed at Jiangling; the Huai King took the throne—this is Emperor Wenzong.

units.zh: 當是時，世延贊畫之功為多。
units.en: At that time Shiyan's contribution to the planning was the greatest.
units.literal: At that time Shiyan's merit in planning was greatest.

units.zh: 文宗即位，世延仍以御史中丞兼翰林學士承旨，以疾乞歸田里，詔不允。
units.en: When Wenzong took the throne, Shiyan remained censor-in-chief and Hanlin expositor-in-chief. He pleaded illness and asked to retire, but the emperor refused.
units.literal: When Emperor Wenzong took the throne, Shiyan still held the posts of censor-in-chief and Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief; pleading illness he begged to return to his fields, but the edict did not permit it.

units.zh: 天曆二年正月，复除江南行臺御史中丞；
units.en: In the first month of the second Tianli year he was again appointed censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate;
units.literal: In the first month of the second year of Tianli he was again appointed censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate;

units.zh: 行次濟州，三月，改集賢大學士；
units.en: stopping at Jizhou on the way; in the third month he was made Grand Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies;
units.literal: en route he stopped at Jizhou; in the third month he was changed to Grand Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies;

units.zh: 六月，又加奎章閣大學士；
units.en: in the sixth month he was further made Grand Academician of the Kuizhang Pavilion;
units.literal: in the sixth month he was further made Grand Academician of the Kuizhang Pavilion;

units.zh: 八月，拜中書平章政事。
units.en: and in the eighth month he was appointed pingzhang of the Secretariat.
units.literal: in the eighth month he was appointed pingzhang of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 冬，世延至京，固辭不允，詔以世延年高多疾，許乘小車入內。
units.en: In winter he reached the capital, declined firmly but was overruled, and was permitted to enter the palace in a small carriage because of his age and illness.
units.literal: In winter Shiyan reached the capital; he firmly declined but was not permitted; an edict allowed Shiyan, advanced in years and often ill, to enter the palace in a small carriage.

units.zh: 至順元年，詔世延與虞集等纂修《皇朝經世大典》，世延屢奏：「臣衰老，乞解中書政務，專意纂修。」
units.en: In the first Zhishun year he was ordered, with Yu Ji and others, to compile the "Imperial Institutions for Governing the Age." Shiyan repeatedly asked to be relieved of Secretariat duties to devote himself to the work alone.
units.literal: In the first year of Zhishun an edict ordered Shiyan, with Yu Ji and others, to compile the "Imperial Dynasty Institutions for Governing the Age"; Shiyan repeatedly memorialized: "Your servant is old and feeble; I beg to be relieved of Secretariat affairs and devote myself solely to compilation."

units.zh: 帝曰：「老臣如卿者無幾，求退之言，後勿復陳。」
units.en: The emperor said, "Old ministers like you are few; do not speak of retiring again."
units.literal: The emperor said: "Old ministers like you are few; do not again present words of retirement."

units.zh: 四月，仍加翰林學士承旨，封魯國公。
units.en: In the fourth month he was again made Hanlin expositor-in-chief and enfeoffed as Duke of Lu.
units.literal: In the fourth month he was again given Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief and enfeoffed as Duke of Lu.

units.zh: 秋，以疾，移文中書致其事，明日即行，養疾於金陵之茅山。
units.en: That autumn, ill, he sent his resignation to the Secretariat, left the next day, and recuperated at Maoshan in Jinling.
units.literal: In autumn, because of illness, he sent a document to the Secretariat resigning his office; the next day he departed and recuperated at Maoshan in Jinling.

units.zh: 詔徵還朝，不能行，二年，改封涼國公。
units.en: He was summoned back but could not travel; in the second year his title was changed to Duke of Liang.
units.literal: An edict summoned him back to court; he could not travel; in the second year his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Liang.

units.zh: 元統二年，詔賜世延錢凡四萬緡。
units.en: In the second year of the Yuantong reign the court bestowed forty thousand strings of cash on him.
units.literal: In the second year of Yuantong an edict bestowed on Shiyan forty thousand strings of cash in all.

units.zh: 至元改元，仍除奎章閣大學士、翰林學士承旨、中書平章政事、魯國公。
units.en: When the Zhiyuan reign began he was again made Grand Academician of the Kuizhang Pavilion, Hanlin expositor-in-chief, pingzhang of the Secretariat, and Duke of Lu.
units.literal: At the change of reign to Zhiyuan he was again appointed Grand Academician of the Kuizhang Pavilion, Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief, pingzhang of the Secretariat, and Duke of Lu.

units.zh: 明年五月，至成都，十一月卒，享年七十有七。
units.en: The following fifth month he reached Chengdu; in the eleventh month he died, aged seventy-seven.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the next year he reached Chengdu; in the eleventh month he died, aged seventy-seven.

units.zh: 至正二年，贈世忠執法佐運翊亮功臣、太保、金紫光祿大夫、上柱國，追封魯國公，諡文忠。
units.en: In the second Zhizheng year he was posthumously honored as Meritorious Minister of Loyal Service to the Age, Grand Preceptor, Jinzi Guanglu dafu, and Superior Pillar of the State, enfeoffed as Duke of Lu with the posthumous name Wenzhong.
units.literal: In the second year of Zhizheng he was posthumously granted the title Meritorious Minister Who Served the Age with Loyal Law and Aided the Mandate, Grand Preceptor, Jinzi Guanglu dafu, and Superior Pillar of the State; enfeoffed as Duke of Lu; posthumous name Wenzhong.

units.zh: 世延歷事凡九朝，揚歷省臺五十餘年，負經濟之資，而將之以忠義，守之以清介，飾之以文學，凡軍國利病，生民休戚，知無不言，而於儒者名教尤拳拳焉。
units.en: Shiyan served nine reigns and spent more than fifty years in provincial administration and the censorate. He had talent for statecraft, disciplined it with loyalty and righteousness, guarded it with integrity, and adorned it with learning. On every matter affecting the state or the people he spoke without reserve, and he was especially devoted to Confucian moral teaching.
units.literal: Shiyan served through nine reigns and rose through the provincial governments and censorate for more than fifty years. He possessed talent for statecraft, tempered it with loyalty and righteousness, guarded it with integrity, and adorned it with literary learning. On every matter of military and state benefit or harm and the people's weal and woe, he spoke without reserve; and toward Confucian moral teaching he was especially earnest.

units.zh: 為文章波瀾浩瀚，一根於理。
units.en: His writings were sweeping in scope and grounded throughout in principle.
units.literal: His literary compositions were vast in scope, all rooted in principle.

units.zh: 嘗較定律令，匯次《風憲宏綱》，行於世。
units.en: He collated statutes and compiled the "Great Compendium of Censorial Regulations," which circulated widely.
units.literal: He once collated statutes and compiled the "Great Compendium of Censorial Regulations," which circulated in the world.

units.zh: 五子，達者三人：野峻台，黃州路總管。
units.en: He had five sons; three distinguished themselves: Yejuntai, prefect of Huangzhou.
units.literal: He had five sons; three achieved distinction: Yejuntai, prefect of Huangzhou Circuit.

units.zh: 次月魯，江浙行省理問官。
units.en: The second, Yuelu, was investigating officer of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat.
units.literal: The second, Yuelu, investigating officer of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat.

units.zh: 伯忽，夔州路總管，天曆初，囊加台據蜀叛，死於難，特贈推忠秉義效節功臣、資善大夫、中書右丞、上護軍，追封蜀郡公，諡忠愍。
units.en: Bohu, prefect of Kuizhou—in the early Tianli reign Nanggal Tai rebelled in Shu and he died in the upheaval. He was posthumously honored as Meritorious Minister Who Died for Loyalty and Righteousness, Zishan dafu, right vice chancellor, and Superior Guardian of the Army, enfeoffed as Duke of Shu with the posthumous name Zhongmin.
units.literal: Bohu, prefect of Kuizhou Circuit—in the early Tianli reign Nanggal Tai seized Shu in rebellion and Bohu died in the turmoil; he was specially granted the title Meritorious Minister Who Promotes Loyalty, Upholds Righteousness, and Died for the Cause, Zishan dafu, Right Vice Chancellor of the Secretariat, and Superior Guardian of the Army; enfeoffed as Duke of Shu Commandery; posthumous name Zhongmin.

units.zh: 孔思晦
units.en: Kong Sihui
units.literal: Kong Sihui

units.zh: 孔思晦，字明道，孔子五十四世孫也。
units.en: Kong Sihui, whose style name was Mingdao, was the fifty-fourth-generation descendant of Confucius.
units.literal: Kong Sihui, styled Mingdao, was the fifty-fourth-generation descendant of Confucius.

units.zh: 資質端重，而性簡默，童丱時，讀書已識大義。
units.en: He was dignified and reserved by nature; even as a boy reading the classics he already understood their larger meaning.
units.literal: His natural endowment was dignified and grave, his nature reserved and silent; as a child studying books he already grasped great principles.

units.zh: 及長，授業於導江張篆，講求義理，於詞章之習，薄而弗為。
units.en: When he came of age he studied under Zhang Zhuan of Daojiang, pursued moral principle, and disdained mere literary ornament.
units.literal: When grown he received instruction from Zhang Zhuan of Daojiang, pursued principles, and held literary ornamentation in little esteem and did not practice it.

units.zh: 家貧，躬耕以為養，雖劇寒暑，而為學未嘗懈，遠近爭聘為子弟師。
units.en: His family was poor and he farmed to support them. Despite bitter heat and cold he never slackened in his studies, and families near and far competed to hire him as a teacher.
units.literal: His family was poor; he personally plowed to support them; though the cold and heat were extreme, he never slackened in study; from near and far people competed to engage him as teacher for their sons.

units.zh: 大德中，遊京師，祭酒耶律有尚欲薦之，以母老，辭而歸。
units.en: During the Dade period he went to the capital, where Libationer Yelü Youshang wished to recommend him for office, but he declined and returned because his mother was elderly.
units.literal: In the Dade period he traveled to the capital; the libationer Yelü Youshang wished to recommend him, but because his mother was old he declined and returned.

units.zh: 母臥疾，躬進藥餌，衣不解帶。
units.en: When his mother fell ill he personally administered her medicine and did not leave her side day or night.
units.literal: When his mother lay ill he personally brought her medicine and did not undo his belt.

units.zh: 居喪，勺水不入口者五日。
units.en: During mourning he took no food or water for five days.
units.literal: In mourning he took no water into his mouth for five days.

units.zh: 至大中，舉茂才，為范陽儒學教諭。
units.en: In the Zhida period he was recommended as maocai and appointed instructor at the Fanyang Confucian school.
units.literal: In the Zhida period he was recommended as maocai and appointed instructor of the Fanyang Confucian school.

units.zh: 延祐初，調寧陽學。
units.en: At the beginning of the Yanyou reign he was transferred to the Ningyang school.
units.literal: At the beginning of Yanyou he was transferred to the Ningyang school.

units.zh: 先是，兩縣校官率以廩薄不能守職，而思晦以儉約自將，教養有法，比代去，學者皆不忍舍之。
units.en: Previously school officers in both counties had often failed to remain in office because stipends were too small, but Sihui lived frugally, taught effectively, and when he left his post the students were unwilling to see him go.
units.literal: Earlier, school officers in both counties generally could not hold their posts because stipends were meager, but Sihui restrained himself through frugality, had effective methods of instruction and nurture, and when his term ended the students all were unwilling to part from him.

units.zh: 於是孔氏族人相與議：思晦嫡長且賢，宜襲封爵，奉祠事。
units.en: The Kong clansmen then agreed that Sihui, as the eldest legitimate son and a man of worth, should inherit the title and perform the sacrifices.
units.literal: Thereupon the Kong clansmen deliberated together: Sihui is the eldest legitimate son and is worthy; he should inherit the enfeoffment and perform the sacrificial duties.

units.zh: 狀上政府，事未決。
units.en: They petitioned the government, but the matter remained undecided.
units.literal: A petition was sent up to the government; the matter was not yet decided.

units.zh: 仁宗在位，雅崇尚儒道，一日，問：「孔子之裔今幾世，襲爵為誰？」
units.en: Emperor Renzong greatly honored Confucian teaching. One day he asked, "How many generations removed are Confucius's descendants now, and who holds the inherited title?"
units.literal: Emperor Renzong on the throne greatly honored Confucian doctrine; one day he asked: "How many generations are Confucius's descendants now, and who holds the inherited title?"

units.zh: 廷臣具對曰：「未定。」
units.en: The court ministers replied, "That has not yet been determined."
units.literal: The court ministers answered in full: "Not yet determined."

units.zh: 帝親取孔氏譜牒按之，曰：「以嫡應襲封者，思晦也，复奚疑！」
units.en: The emperor personally examined the Kong genealogical records and said, "The legitimate heir to the title is Sihui—what room for doubt remains!"
units.literal: The emperor personally took the Kong clan genealogical records and examined them, saying: "He who by legitimate descent should inherit the enfeoffment is Sihui—what further doubt is there!"

units.zh: 特授中議大夫，襲封衍聖公，月俸百緡，加至五百緡，賜四品印。
units.en: He was specially appointed Zhongyi dafu and inherited the title Duke of Continuing Sagacity, with a monthly stipend of one hundred strings later raised to five hundred, and was granted a fourth-rank seal.
units.literal: He was specially appointed Zhongyi dafu, inherited the enfeoffment as Duke of Continuing Sagacity, with a monthly salary of a hundred strings, increased to five hundred strings, and granted a seal of the fourth rank.

units.zh: 泰定三年，山東廉訪副使王鵬南言：「襲爵上公，而階止四品，於格弗稱，且失尊崇意。」
units.en: In the third Taiding year Wang Pengnan, vice commissioner of the Shandong Surveillance Commission, said, "He holds a ducal title of the highest honor, yet his rank is only fourth grade—this neither fits the regulations nor shows due respect."
units.literal: In the third year of Taiding, Vice Commissioner Wang Pengnan of the Shandong Surveillance Commission said: "He inherits a title of exalted duke, yet his rank is only fourth grade—this does not match the regulations and also fails the intent of honoring him."

units.zh: 明年，升嘉議大夫。
units.en: The following year he was promoted to Jiayi dafu.
units.literal: The next year he was promoted to Jiayi dafu.

units.zh: 至順二年，改賜三品印。
units.en: In the second Zhishun year he was granted a third-rank seal in place of the former one.
units.literal: In the second year of Zhishun he was given a seal of the third rank in place of the former one.

units.zh: 思晦以宗祀責重，恆懼弗勝，每遇祭祀，必敬必慎。
units.en: Because the duty of ancestral sacrifice weighed heavily on him, Sihui constantly feared he might fail in it; at every rite he was utterly reverent and careful.
units.literal: Sihui, because the responsibility for ancestral sacrifice was weighty, constantly feared he could not bear it; whenever sacrifice came due he was invariably reverent and careful.

units.zh: 初，廟毀於兵，後雖苟完，而角樓圍牆未備，思晦竭力營度，以復其舊。
units.en: The temple had been destroyed in war and only roughly repaired afterward; the corner towers and walls were still incomplete. Sihui threw himself into restoring it to its former condition.
units.literal: At first the temple had been destroyed in warfare; though later it was patched together, the corner towers and enclosing walls were not complete—Sihui labored with all his strength to plan and restore it to its former state.

units.zh: 金絲堂壞，又一新之，祭器禮服，悉加整飭。
units.en: He rebuilt the ruined Jinsi Hall and put all sacrificial vessels and ritual garments in proper order.
units.literal: The Jinsi Hall was ruined and he rebuilt it anew; sacrificial vessels and ritual garments were all put in good order.

units.zh: 又以尼山乃毓聖之地，故有廟，已毀，民冒耕祭田且百年，思晦復其田，且請置尼山書院，以列於學官，朝廷從之。
units.en: Nishan, where the Sage had been nurtured, also had a temple that had been destroyed, and for nearly a century locals had encroached on its sacrificial fields. Sihui recovered the land and petitioned to establish a Nishan Academy among the official schools; the court agreed.
units.literal: Moreover, since Nishan was the place where the Sage was nurtured and there had been a temple there, already destroyed, and commoners had for nearly a century encroached on and farmed the sacrificial fields, Sihui recovered the fields and also requested establishment of a Nishan Academy to be listed among the official schools—the court assented.

units.zh: 三氏學舊有田三千畝，佔於豪民，子思書院舊有營運錢萬緡，貸於民取子錢，以供祭祀，久之，民不輸子錢，並負其本，思晦皆理而復之。
units.en: The Three-Clan School's three thousand mu of fields had been seized by powerful families, and the Zisi Academy's ten thousand strings of operating funds had been lent at interest for sacrifices until borrowers defaulted on interest and principal alike. Sihui recovered all of it.
units.literal: The Three-Clan School formerly had three thousand mu of fields occupied by powerful families; the Zisi Academy formerly had ten thousand strings of operating funds lent to the people at interest to supply sacrifices—over time the people did not pay interest and also owed the principal; Sihui settled all these and restored them.

units.zh: 聖父舊封齊國公，思晦言於朝曰：「宣聖封王，而父爵猶公，願加褒崇。」
units.en: Confucius's father had been enfeoffed as Duke of Qi. Sihui petitioned the court, "The Exalted Sage was made a king, yet his father's title remains only duke. I ask that greater honor be granted."
units.literal: The Sage's father had formerly been enfeoffed as Duke of Qi; Sihui spoke to the court: "The Exalted Sage was enfeoffed as king, yet his father's title remains duke—I wish for added honor."

units.zh: 乃詔加封聖父啟聖王，聖母王夫人。
units.en: An edict then enfeoffed the Sage's father as King Qisheng and his mother as royal consort.
units.literal: An edict then added the enfeoffment of the Sage's father as King Qisheng and the Sage's mother as royal consort.

units.zh: 五季時，孔末之後方盛，欲以偽滅真，害宣聖子孫幾盡，至是，其裔复欲冒稱宣聖後。
units.en: During the Five Dynasties the descendants of Kong Mo had nearly wiped out the true line in an attempt to supplant it; now their descendants again sought falsely to claim descent from Confucius.
units.literal: In the Five Dynasties period the descendants of Kong Mo had been flourishing and wished to supplant the true line with a false one, nearly exterminating the descendants of the Exalted Sage; at this time their offspring again wished falsely to claim descent from the Exalted Sage.

units.zh: 思晦以為：「不早辨則真偽久益不可明，彼與我不共戴天，乃列於族，與共拜殿庭，可乎？」
units.en: Sihui said, "If we do not settle this soon, truth and falsehood will become impossible to distinguish. They are our hereditary enemies—how can they be listed in the clan and worship beside us in the temple hall?"
units.literal: Sihui held: "If we do not distinguish early, true and false will long grow impossible to clarify; they and I are irreconcilable enemies—yet they are to be listed in the clan and worship together in the hall court—can this be permitted?"

units.zh: 遂會族人，稽典故斥之，既又重刻宗譜於石，而孔氏族裔益明矣。
units.en: He convened the clan, cited precedent to reject them, and had the genealogy recarved on stone so that the true Kong lineage was made unmistakably clear.
units.literal: He then assembled the clansmen, examined ancient precedents to repudiate them, and afterward had the clan genealogy carved anew in stone, so that the Kong clan descendants became still clearer.

units.zh: 元統元年卒，年六十七。
units.en: He died in the first year of the Yuantong reign, aged sixty-seven.
units.literal: In the first year of Yuantong he died, aged sixty-seven.

units.zh: 卒之日，有鶴百餘翔其屋上，又見神光自東南落其舍北。
units.en: On the day he died more than a hundred cranes circled his roof, and a divine light was seen descending from the southeast onto the north side of his house.
units.literal: On the day of his death more than a hundred cranes circled above his house, and a divine light was seen falling from the southeast onto the north of his dwelling.

units.zh: 至正中，朝廷加贈其官，而賜諡曰文肅。
units.en: In the Zhizheng period the court added to his posthumous honors and granted him the posthumous name Wensu.
units.literal: In the Zhizheng period the court added to his posthumous offices and granted the posthumous name Wensu.

units.zh: 子曰克堅，襲封衍聖公，階嘉議大夫，既而進通奉大夫。
units.en: His son Kejian inherited the title Duke of Continuing Sagacity as Jiayi dafu and was later promoted to Tongfeng dafu.
units.literal: His son was Kejian, who inherited the enfeoffment as Duke of Continuing Sagacity, rank Jiayi dafu, and was later advanced to Tongfeng dafu.

units.zh: 至正十五年，召為同知太常禮儀院事，拜陝西行臺侍御史，遷國子祭酒，擢山東肅政廉訪使，不赴。
units.en: In the fifteenth Zhizheng year he was summoned as vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, made attendant censor of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate, then libationer of the Directorate of Education, and promoted commissioner of the Shandong Surveillance Commission, which he declined.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year of Zhizheng he was summoned as vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, appointed attendant censor of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate, transferred to libationer of the Directorate of Education, and promoted commissioner of the Shandong Surveillance Commission but did not take up the post.

units.zh: 孫希學，襲封衍聖公。
units.en: His grandson Xixue inherited the title Duke of Continuing Sagacity.
units.literal: His grandson was Xixue, who inherited the enfeoffment as Duke of Continuing Sagacity.
